content_queue_queries.ai_eligibility:
SELECT j.company_code,j.status,j.api_assistant,j.attempts,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN j.reply_message_id IS NULL AND j.status IN ('pending','error') AND j.attempts<3
       AND j.next_attempt_at<=:margin_end AND (j.api_assistant=0 OR EXISTS
       (SELECT 1 FROM project_chat_rooms r WHERE r.company_code=j.company_code AND r.api_assistant=1))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) eligible_in_window,
      SUM(CASE WHEN j.status='running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) startup_requeues
      FROM project_chat_ai_jobs j GROUP BY j.company_code,j.status,j.api_assistant,j.attempts
content_queue_queries.delivery_alert_events:
SELECT o.company_code,o.status,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hugh_owner_alerts a WHERE a.event_key='delivery:'||o.id)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_events FROM project_chat_outbox o
      JOIN project_chat_ai_jobs j ON j.reply_message_id=o.message_id JOIN project_chat_messages m ON m.id=o.message_id
      WHERE j.api_assistant=1 AND (o.status IN ('error','uncertain') OR (o.status<>'sent' AND m.created_at<:sixty_seconds_before))
      GROUP BY o.company_code,o.status
content_queue_queries.potential_delay_effects:
SELECT j.company_code,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hugh_owner_alerts a WHERE a.event_key='delay:'||j.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_alerts,
      SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_chat_acknowledged_jobs a WHERE a.job_id=j.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_acks
      FROM project_chat_ai_jobs j JOIN project_chat_rooms r ON r.company_code=j.company_code
      JOIN project_chat_messages m ON m.id=j.message_id WHERE j.api_assistant=1 AND r.api_assistant=1
      AND j.status<>'done' AND j.reply_message_id IS NULL AND (m.created_at<:sixty_seconds_before OR j.attempts>=3)
      GROUP BY j.company_code
content_queue_queries.active_mirror_tasks:
SELECT t.company_code,t.status,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN l.chat_task_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_local_link
      FROM project_chat_tasks t JOIN project_chat_rooms r ON r.company_code=t.company_code
      LEFT JOIN task_dispatch_links l ON l.chat_task_id=t.id WHERE r.api_assistant=1
      AND t.external_ref LIKE 'api-assistant:%' AND t.status NOT IN ('done','cancelled') GROUP BY t.company_code,t.status
content_queue_queries.stale_task_alerts:
SELECT t.company_code,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hugh_owner_alerts a WHERE a.event_key='stale:'||t.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_events
      FROM project_chat_tasks t JOIN project_chat_rooms r ON r.company_code=t.company_code WHERE r.api_assistant=1
      AND t.external_ref LIKE 'api-assistant:%' AND t.status NOT IN ('done','cancelled') AND t.updated_at<:fifteen_minutes_before
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_chat_task_notes n WHERE n.task_id=t.id AND n.created_at>=:fifteen_minutes_before)
      GROUP BY t.company_code
content_queue_queries.owner_alerts:
SELECT company_code,status,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' AND next_attempt_at<=:margin_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) eligible_in_window
      FROM hugh_owner_alerts GROUP BY company_code,status
content_queue_queries.client_bot_outbox:
SELECT company_code,kind,status,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN next_attempt_at<=:margin_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) due_in_window,
      SUM(CASE WHEN claimed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) claimed
      FROM client_bot_outbox GROUP BY company_code,kind,status
content_queue_queries.site_order_outbox:
SELECT site,company_code,transport,status,COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN next_attempt_at<=:margin_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) due_in_window,
      SUM(CASE WHEN claimed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) claimed
      FROM site_order_outbox GROUP BY site,company_code,transport,status
content_queue_queries.budget_reservation_states: SELECT state,COUNT(*) n FROM hugh_fallback_reservations GROUP BY state
content_queue_queries.provider_state:
SELECT name,enabled,revision,config_revision,check_state,checked_revision,
      CASE WHEN length(encrypted_key)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END key_present FROM hugh_provider_settings ORDER BY name
content_queue_queries.recent_review_runs:
SELECT company_code,run_date,phase,target_date,status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(attempts) max_attempts
      FROM content_review_reminder_runs WHERE run_date>=:yesterday_msk GROUP BY company_code,run_date,phase,target_date,status
content_queue_queries.recent_review_item_counts:
SELECT company_code,publish_date,COUNT(*) n FROM content_review_reminder_items
      WHERE publish_date>=:yesterday_msk GROUP BY company_code,publish_date

final_content_queries.budget_recovery:
SELECT provider,state,COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='held' AND created_at<=:stale_reservation_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) startup_recover_writes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='held' AND created_at<=:stale_reservation_cutoff_window THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) may_recover_in_window
 FROM hugh_fallback_reservations GROUP BY provider,state
final_content_queries.economy_meta: SELECT COUNT(*) existing_singleton FROM ai_economy_meta WHERE id=1
final_content_queries.push_envelopes:
WITH latest AS (SELECT key,MAX(version) version FROM documents
 WHERE key LIKE 'palitra-push-private/v1/job/%' GROUP BY key)
 SELECT COUNT(*) latest_job_envelopes,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN json_valid(d.body) THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(d.body,'$.active')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END),0) active_envelopes,
 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT json_valid(d.body) THEN 1
 WHEN json_extract(d.body,'$.schema') IS NOT 1 OR json_extract(d.body,'$.cipher') IS NOT 'aes-256-gcm'
 OR COALESCE(json_type(d.body,'$.active'),'') NOT IN ('true','false') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) invalid_metadata
 FROM documents d JOIN latest v ON d.key=v.key AND d.version=v.version

final_crm_queries.dispatch_states:
SELECT company_code,state,attempts,COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='queued' AND next_at<=:as_of_ms THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) claimable_now,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='queued' AND next_at<=:margin_end_ms THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) claimable_in_window,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='running' AND lease_until<=:margin_end_ms AND attempts<2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) may_requeue,
 SUM(CASE WHEN state='running' AND lease_until<=:margin_end_ms AND attempts>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) may_block_and_alert
 FROM task_dispatch GROUP BY company_code,state,attempts
final_crm_queries.reconcile_cancellations:
SELECT d.company_code,d.state,COUNT(*) n FROM task_dispatch d LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.id=d.task_id
 WHERE d.state NOT IN ('done','cancelled') AND (t.id IS NULL OR t.is_deleted=1 OR t.company_code<>d.company_code
 OR t.status IN ('done','cancelled')) GROUP BY d.company_code,d.state
final_crm_queries.dispatch_alerts: SELECT company_code,handed_off,COUNT(*) n FROM task_dispatch_alerts GROUP BY company_code,handed_off
